title: The 3n map trio: no congruence can prove non-halting
text: 1RB0LD_1LC0RA_1RA1LB_1LA1LE_1RF0LC_---0RE, 1RB1LC_1RC0LD_1LA0RB_1LB1LE_1RF0LA_---0RE and 1RB1RE_1LC0RA_1RD0LB_1LB1RC_1LF0RD_---0LE halt exactly when the orbit of n → 3n − 10·2<sup>k</sup> + 3k + 14 lands on some h<sub>k</sub> = 5·2<sup>k</sup> − k − 6. Lean (kernel) now proves that no set of residue classes mod any divisor of 2<sup>16</sup>·3<sup>9</sup> holds any of the three orbits, is kept by the map and misses every h<sub>k</sub>: whether a step raises the level depends on the size of n, not its residues, and a checked path of 34 such choices reaches the residue of h<sub>k</sub>. A search finds the same for every modulus up to 20,000.
